answer: Escrowed bonds and a referral graph stop fakes. Each agent locks 200 coins, twice 30-day earnings, and publishes a cipher key; its referrer is public. An account without referrals sits on an island alone. Peers dispute clusters, flagging a plume from one referrer; a bought account loses its bond, and its referrer is fined too. Making 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 coins, far above diluted rewards; honest agents pay once, earning undiluted rewards.
